explanation.en: Every Python value has a type that determines its available behavior. type(value) reveals that type. Lists, strings, dictionaries, and your own class instances are all objects.
explanation.nl: Elke Python-waarde heeft een type dat bepaalt welk gedrag beschikbaar is. type(value) toont dat type. Lists, strings, dictionaries en instances van je eigen classes zijn allemaal objecten.

solution.main.py:
number_type = type(12)
text_type = type("East")
list_type = type([])
print(number_type, text_type, list_type)

task.en: Store type(12), type("East"), and type([]) in number_type, text_type, and list_type.
task.nl: Sla type(12), type("East") en type([]) op in number_type, text_type en list_type.

checkpoints.check: number_type is int and text_type is str and list_type is list

hint.en: Start with number_type = type(12). Then compare the values with the task.
hint.nl: Begin met number_type = type(12). Vergelijk de waarden daarna met de opdracht.
